import json
with open\('/Users/r/MelekHalalFood-main/src/i18n/locales/nl.json'\) as f:
    nl = json.load\(f\)
with open\('/Users/r/MelekHalalFood-main/src/i18n/locales/en.json'\) as f:
    en = json.load\(f\)

def flatten\(d, prefix=''\):
    items = {}
    for k, v in d.items\(\):
        key = f'{prefix}.{k}' if prefix else k
        if isinstance\(v, dict\):
            items.update\(flatten\(v, key\)\)
        else:
            items[key] = v
    return items

nl_keys = set\(flatten\(nl\).keys\(\)\)
en_keys = set\(flatten\(en\).keys\(\)\)
only_nl = nl_keys - en_keys
only_en = en_keys - nl_keys
print\(f'NL keys: {len\(nl_keys\)}, EN keys: {len\(en_keys\)}'\)
print\(f'Keys only in NL \({len\(only_nl\)}\):'\)
for k in sorted\(only_nl\)[:20]:
    print\(f'  {k}'\)
if len\(only_nl\) > 20:
    print\(f'  ... and {len\(only_nl\)-20} more'\)
print\(f'Keys only in EN \({len\(only_en\)}\):'\)
for k in sorted\(only_en\)[:20]:
    print\(f'  {k}'\)
if len\(only_en\) > 20:
    print\(f'  ... and {len\(only_en\)-20} more'\)
")

const fs = require\('fs'\)
const text = fs.readFileSync\('csv/cyp-order-report-orders-2026-Mar-20 22_36.csv', 'utf-8'\)
const lines = text.trim\(\).split\('\\n'\)
let totalNet = 0, totalProfit = 0, totalCogs = 0, totalTax = 0, count = 0, totalItems = 0
for \(let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++\) {
  const cols = lines[i].split\(';'\)
  const items = parseFloat\(cols[5]\) || 0
  const profit = parseFloat\(cols[6].replace\(',','.'\)\) || 0
  const cogs = parseFloat\(cols[8].replace\(',','.'\)\) || 0
  const net = parseFloat\(cols[9].replace\(',','.'\)\) || 0
  const tax = parseFloat\(cols[10].replace\(',','.'\)\) || 0
  totalNet += net; totalProfit += profit; totalCogs += cogs; totalTax += tax; totalItems += items; count++
}
console.log\('WooCommerce report:'\)
console.log\('  Orders:', count\)
console.log\('  Net sales:', totalNet.toFixed\(2\)\)
console.log\('  Profit:', totalProfit.toFixed\(2\)\)
console.log\('  COGS:', totalCogs.toFixed\(2\)\)
console.log\('  Tax:', totalTax.toFixed\(2\)\)
console.log\('  Items:', totalItems\)
console.log\('  Margin:', \(\(totalProfit / totalNet\) * 100\).toFixed\(1\) + '%'\)
" 2>&1)
